# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-10

This Xteink X4 release incorporates the latest official CrossPoint improvements while preserving the fork's Nunito interface, reading statistics, and OTA behavior.

## Added

- Added script-group metadata and script-based grouping to the downloadable font manager.
- Added an option to strip embedded fonts during EPUB optimization in the web file manager.

## Fixed

- Fixed stale sleep-screen content remaining beneath the Home screen after a splashless wake.
- Fixed EPUB chapters containing trailing non-XML data after the closing HTML tag.
- Added support for the `&apos;` HTML entity.
- Fixed SD font scanning when a generated font ID is negative.
- Fixed unnecessary dithering for opaque BMP sleep overlays.

## Changed

- Updated the FreeInk SDK, including lower frontlight brightness support for X4 Pro.
- Kept Nunito as the built-in interface and reader font instead of adopting the upstream Ubuntu Medium UI font.

## Notes

- This release contains firmware for Xteink X4 only.
